name: DROP
description: Discrete Reasoning Over Paragraphs requires models to perform discrete operations (addition, subtraction, counting, sorting, comparison) over paragraphs from Wikipedia articles. Questions require identifying relevant numerical or temporal information from text and applying arithmetic or logical operations, testing a combination of reading comprehension and symbolic reasoning.
reputation: Introduced a novel reading comprehension paradigm requiring arithmetic; published at NAACL 2019; cited in hundreds of papers; still included in some evaluation suites
notes: Approaching saturation for frontier models but still used in evaluation harnesses. Pioneered the idea of combining reading comprehension with discrete mathematical operations. Part of the Open LLM Leaderboard v2 evaluation suite. Questions require grounding arithmetic in natural language context, which proved challenging for early neural models.
